requirements.text: User can scan medication bottle barcode using phone camera
Scanned barcode auto-populates drug details if found in local inventory or previous import
If barcode not found, prompt manual entry with barcode pre-filled
Manual entry form for all veterinary drug fields (name, generic, manufacturer, concentration, form, size, category, location, expiration, lot, controlled, unit)
Quantity on hand entry adds to count (add mode) with option to set/override
Inventory list with search/filter by name/barcode/location and shows current counts
Excel import: parse template file and load into app
Excel export: generate file with columns in exact template order, only qty intended for edit
Multi-phone compile: import multiple exported files and merge (add quantities for existing, add new items)
Offline-first: all counting works without network
Final export ready to copy into protected master template
